players.product: antibody discovery and multispecific T-cell engager platform

contracts.signal: Announcement terms of the Jazz Pharmaceuticals preclinical research collaboration, option and license agreement for next-generation T-cell engaging multispecific antibodies against multiple gastrointestinal cancers and other solid tumors: AbCellera performs discovery and early-stage research; Jazz holds an option on each research program and, after exercising it and paying an option fee, the exclusive worldwide right to develop and commercialize each program. Should Jazz exercise its option, AbCellera is eligible to receive up to $792 million per program in option fees and development, regulatory and commercial sales milestone payments. AbCellera may also, by mutual agreement, conduct certain investigational new drug-enabling studies and manufacture clinical supply for any program.
contracts.value: up to $792 million per program in option fees and milestone payments
contracts.type: research collaboration, option and license agreement
